verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a hosted identity and payments platform like Skyfire, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out. The closest item is KYA tokens disclosing only the identity fields a service requires, which is data minimization in transactions, not opting out of telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
